# Peter Kahenya

> Software engineer in Nairobi, Kenya. Forward Deployed Engineer at Turing, building agentic AI workflows, MCP services and production APIs. Previously backend, data and automation work at VibesMeet, Humentum and PwC.

This file summarizes https://peterkahenya.com/ in plain Markdown. Keep it in sync with index.html.

## Experience

- Forward Deployed Engineer, Turing (Aug 2025 - present): agentic workflows, agentic tools and MCP services for third-party LLMs, reinforcement learning environments for evaluating agents on tool use and computer use, production APIs
- Lead Backend Engineer (Contract), VibesMeet LLC (Mar 2025 - Jul 2025): split a monolith into microservices on AWS Lambda; recommendation engine on AWS Personalize that doubled engagement and retention
- Senior Fullstack Engineer, Humentum (Nov 2023 - Mar 2025): training platform serving 16K+ users a month across 15+ countries; data pipelines (Airflow, Alteryx, Microsoft Fabric) for funder dashboards; compliance automation that cut execution time by 50%
- Senior Associate, Tax Technology, PwC (Mar 2021 - Nov 2023): reporting and compliance applications including e-invoicing; RPA (UiPath) and ETL (Alteryx, Power BI) that cut audit effort by 60%
- Software Engineer, Kipya Africa (Oct 2019 - Dec 2020): e-commerce platform with real-time video and chat support

- Data & BI: Airflow, Alteryx, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI
- Automation & RPA: Zapier, Make, n8n, UiPath
